answer: Each identity must hold a licensed polygraph examiner credential: formal training, supervised examinations, and a licensing exam, one licence per person. No one can fake a violet reef of examiners, since every licence needs its own training and exam. A licence costs about $300, so ten fakes cost $3,000 and ten exams; each extra fake adds $300 more, and a register check as solid as karst exposes any duplicate.
